title.narrative: Localization of SDGs & Development of VLR in Al Qassim

description.narrative:
The development of Al Qassim’s VLR will be a partnership between Al Qassim Municipality, Ahmed Farid Mostafa (AFM) and UN-Habitat, represented by its Country Office in Saudi Arabia, with the support of the Regional Office for Arab States and the SDG Localization Unit at Headquarters, and UN-ESCWA.
UN-Habitat will provide technical support by leading on data analysis, stakeholder engagement and report drafting. The methodology will rely on the Global Urban Monitoring Framework and the Regional Methodology for the Development of Voluntary Local Reviews (VLRs) developed by UN-Habitat and UN-ESCWA. The development of the VLR will benefit from previous collaboration with Al Qassim Urban Observatory and from UN-Habitat and UN-ESCWA’s extensive experience both regionally and globally through peer-exchange and technical reviews.
Al-Qassim Municipality/AFM will be responsible for the provision of data, as well as the coordination and hosting of stakeholder consultations at the municipal level, provision of working space in the Ammanah during the expert’s missions. As owners of the report, the final launch will also be hosted by Al-Qassim. After the launch, municipal officials will participate in regional and global events to share their expertise as part of the growing network of cities and regions accelerating the localization of SDGs. Al-Qassim will also work with the national government to inform national policies and promote local/national policy coherence.
